SELECT a.COMPONENTE as COMPONENTE,a.DESCRIPCION as DESCRIPCION,aa.NOMBRE as NOMBRE,aa.TIPO as TIPO,aa.IDXATLDEPLOYMENT as IDXATLDEPLOYMENT,aa.DEPLOYMENT as DEPLOYMENT,a.IDXATLCOMPONENT as IDXATLCOMPONENT FROM ATLCOMPONENT a
 INNER JOIN 
ATLRCOMPDEPLOY ab ON ab.IDATLCOMPONENT0 = a.IDXATLCOMPONENT INNER JOIN 
ATLDEPLOYMENT aa ON aa.IDXATLDEPLOYMENT = ab.IDATLDEPLOYMENT0;
